entries.title: Age of Mythology
entries.definitive_edition: Age of Mythology: Retold on Windows

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC Retold build at modern resolution

primary.why: Age of Mythology: Retold is the current official modern remake/remaster route with the strongest visual and platform support. Original and Extended Edition releases remain comparison paths for old balance/UI behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use Age of Mythology: Retold on Windows with the current patch. If archiving the exact 2002 behavior, do a separate original/Extended comparison note rather than replacing the Retold primary.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record patch/DLC state for Retold. Treat original and Extended Edition as comparison routes, not the main path.
